UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office / May 2025 (DevTracker listing)
FCDO–UNHCR memorandum D0007515

primary donor grant agreement · UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

HTTP 200; OpenDocument XML reviewed with text spacing restored. Activity period 15 November 2024–31 March 2025 and original £10 million ceiling cover several activities. FCDO signature block says 14 November; partner day is redacted. Later amendment refers to signature on 20 November. The final narrative/financial report required by paragraph 24 was not obtained. No page-image review is claimed.

UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office / May 2025 (DevTracker listing)
FCDO–UNHCR grant amendment no. 1/2025, D0007516

primary donor grant amendment · UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

HTTP 200; OpenDocument XML reviewed. The ceiling increases by £1,360,738 to £11,360,738. FCDO date is 26 February 2025; partner day is redacted. A ceiling across several activities does not establish winter-cash receipts or spending. No page-image review is claimed.

UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office / November 2025 (DevTracker listing)
HARP annual review, S40017629, dated 16 November 2025

primary donor programme review · UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

HTTP 200; OpenDocument XML reviewed, including table labels. The review covers October 2024–June 2025. The 53% cash result concerns the inter-agency plan, not UNHCR alone. Data-cleansing delay is attributed particularly to URCS under another programme. Paragraph 43 summarizes UNHCR third-party monitoring; the underlying monitoring report was not obtained. No page-image review is claimed.

Sixth Administrative Court of Appeal of Ukraine / 2025-11-13 (registry public-access date)
Snovsk winter-aid list failures: appeal judgment in case 620/6119/25

primary administrative appeal judgment · Sixth Administrative Court of Appeal of Ukraine

Judgment dated 5 November 2025; full text made 10 November, publicly accessible 13 November. Appeal dismissed and 18 July judgment left unchanged. Local disciplinary administrative litigation, not a criminal conviction or national UNHCR audit. No later cassation found; absence of one is not established.

UNHCR / Not established (2025 report)
Cash assistance in 2025: Main outcomes from post distribution monitoring

primary global monitoring report · UNHCR

Global monitoring publication with a Ukraine winter case study on p. 7. Exact publication date not established; the file path includes 2026-03. This is distinct from the 19-page Ukraine regular-MPCA report 123671.
